editorial:
If you love a good con movie with sharp banter and chemistry, Duplicity is a fun ride. Julia Roberts and Clive Owen play Claire and Ray, two former spies who are also lovers, trying to pull off a massive corporate heist. They bounce between rival companies, trading secrets and flirtatious jabs while pretending to be on opposite sides. The vibe is sleek, stylish, and full of twists that keep you guessing who is really playing who.

The acting is the big draw here. Roberts and Owen have great chemistry, and the supporting cast adds plenty of laughs. The pacing is quick, with lots of flashbacks that fill in the backstory. On the downside, the plot can get confusing if you're not paying close attention, and some twists feel a bit too clever. Still, it's a smart, entertaining watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Claire and Ray believe they've successfully stolen the secret formula and secured their fortune. But the twist reveals the formula they took was a fake, and the real innovation was already patented by someone else. Their bosses had been playing them the whole time. Claire and Ray end up with nothing but each other, realizing they were outsmarted in their own game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves smart con movies with romance and sharp dialogue.
